full_judgment: 169. PW 44 Md Shohrab Hossain, having appeared before the Court deposed to the effect that on 3-10-1997 while he was working as SI of Police at Dhanmondi Police Station and was in-charge of Malkhana, at about 11-05 hours Mr Abdul Kahar Akand of cm Dhaka having gone to Dhanmondi Police Station, had seized certain register, such as Lalbagh Police Station Khatian Register, marked as Exhibit 16 which contains serial No. 1454 (3) Case No. 11 dated 4-11-1975 and the place of occurrence at Central Jail, Dhaka. He also proved Exhibits 17, 18, 19, 20, 21 and 22 before the Court.
